structured.answer: I'd open a securities account at פסגות ניירות ערך and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", the pair the page marks as cheapest. With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years the page says about 179,889 ₪ in today's money, against 135,000 ₪ put in, assuming 2% inflation and 7% return a year.
